svg.title: Oblivion Seal — Rites of Unmaking. Draft 3 / Shadow classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Brand of Oblivion forks into Umbral Claws then Absolute Erasure, or Unraveled Wards then Writ of Oblivion. Umbral Refuge forks into Veil of Nothing then Sealed Against Ruin, or Hungering Shade then Maw of Oblivion. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Shadow-classified Oblivion Seal jutsu.
svg.metadata: {"title":"Oblivion Seal \u2014 Rites of Unmaking","revision":"Draft 3 / Shadow classification / forked tree","bloodline":{"id":"wasIGmDuczwD9PB89gML6","review_id":"BR-053","name":"Oblivion Seal","rank":"A","statClassification":"Highest","traits":"Burst, Sustained DPS"},"classification":{"potency_classification":"Shadow","label_kind":"element","bloodline":"Oblivion Seal","display_element":"Shadow","element_exclusive_within_census":false,"applies_to":"existing supported tags of every Oblivion Seal jutsu","changes_combat_elements":false,"engine_status":"proposal_requires_resolver_adjustment","census_collisions":["Adorable Shadow of Death","Blood-Enchanted Eyes","Blood-Enshrined Eyes","Blood-Enthralled Eyes","Extinction Herald","Godstorm Eclipse","Infernal Reaper","Kusamochi: Mashumaro Executioner","Lilac Seductress","Night Parade of A Thousand Demons","Otaku of the Dark Maiden","Sacrament of Crimson Hunger","Shadow Weaver"]},"emphasis":{"primary":"Damage (three Shadow attacks)","secondary":"Increase Damage Taken and Increase Damage Given (Shadowrend exposure, Cursed Beast Form empowerment)","tertiary":"Shadow Surge sustain (Decrease Damage Taken, Lifesteal)","rationale":"Three of the seven supported rows are Shadow Damage on 60 AP single-target casts (Cursed Beast Form 40, Curse Empowerment 40, Shadow Tether 50 at jutsu level 25) and the bloodline's traits are Burst and Sustained DPS, so offense is the declared primary and the Damage route reaches all three attacks. Shadowrend's 35% Increase Damage Taken (element-less, all four stat types listed) and Cursed Beast Form's 35% Increase Damage Given (Fire, Lightning, Shadow and element-less hits) are the two single-row amplifiers that make later strikes land harder (each is live the two rounds after its cast, never its own hit); exposure gets a full route held to the +7 ceiling, empowerment is the Foundation-plus-capstone glue (+5 ceiling). Shadow Surge is the kit's only self-cast (40 AP, cooldown 7); its Decrease Damage Taken 35% and Lifesteal 40% are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time and live the two rounds after it, not circle effects. They are tertiary by kit identity but, being single rows, carry the largest flats (+10 each). Decrease Damage Taken mirrors Taiyo Kami's Sovereign Sun route (the same 2/3/5 shape on a 40 AP self-cast); Lifesteal has no reference analogue, so its +10 is set against the 60% leech cap (50% leaves 10 points of vamp headroom) and is recorded as an open decision in risks. No Afterburn, Reflect, Heal or Decrease Damage Given rows exist, so none is invented."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Brand of Oblivion","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"The seal brands both hands: the one that curses and the one that is cursed.","coverage_note":"Cursed Beast Form self buff 35\u219237% (Fire, Lightning, Shadow, element-less hits); Shadowrend exposure 35\u219237% (non-pierce); next 2 rounds.","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Shadow","scope":"Oblivion Seal jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Cursed Beast Form","Shadowrend"],"effect_rows":2}},{"id":"02","name":"Umbral Claws","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"The beast's shadow lengthens, and its claws find more of you.","coverage_note":"Cursed Beast Form 40\u219242, Curse Empowerment 40\u219242, Shadow Tether 50\u219252 (Shadow, single target, range 4, 60 AP, cooldown 7). Oblivion"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Reference reuse: topology and five nodes copy Taiyo Kami nearly verbatim (Brand of Oblivion = Dawnheart; Umbral Claws, Absolute Erasure = Crown of Cinders, Solar Cataclysm; Veil of Nothing, Sealed Against Ruin = Golden Mantle, Sovereign Sun). It fits a near-identical row mix: three Damage rows and one row per modifier tag. Departures: with no Afterburn or Decrease Damage Given rows, the exposure branch is Increase Damage Taken only (+7 ceiling) and the Surge root takes Lifesteal (2/3/5).","Capstone secondaries never sit on a sibling Hidden Art's tag: Writ of Oblivion and Sealed Against Ruin take +3 Increase Damage Given (no Hidden Art carries it); Maw of Oblivion takes +2 Decrease Damage Taken, below Veil of Nothing's +3. Absolute Erasure is Damage-only, like Solar Cataclysm. Unraveled Wards is held to +2 on purpose: the exposure route is capped at +7, and after Brand's +2 and Writ's +3 primary, +2 is the remainder; 2/3/2 would rank the Hidden Art above its capstone.","Passives and downstream reach: the bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given 25% + 0.15/level on Lightning, Fire, Shadow, None) is not a potency target, but Cursed Beast Form's buff row has the same element list, so the +5 glue raises the kit's later Shadow attacks, Fire and Lightning jutsu, basic attacks and non-elemental jutsu in the 2 rounds after its cast. Shadowrend's exposure lists all four stat types with no element, so every non-pierce hit from any source on the exposed target qualifies.","Delivery: all five jutsu are cooldown 7; four are 60 AP, single target, range 4. Shadow Surge is a 40 AP EMPTY_GROUND circle, but its Decrease Damage Taken and Lifesteal are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 980-1004); the unsupported move row is the only positional row. Rows are live the two rounds after their cast round, never in it (\u00a73b): Surge plus Cursed Beast Form in one 100 AP round, Shadowrend next, then Shadow Tether puts all four windows on that strike.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Umbral Refuge (Surge sustain) or Unraveled Wards (39% exposure); Exposure takes Umbral Refuge or Umbral Claws (+2 power); Fortress takes Brand of Oblivion (40% buff) or Hungering Shade (45% lifesteal, 38% buff, no exposure); Sustain takes Brand of Oblivion or Veil of Nothing (42% reduction, no offense). All 14 full-budget allocations are non-dominated. Value options for review: Lifesteal 2/3/4 (+9); Unraveled Wards +3 with Writ +2 exposure.","Ten nodes: five supported tags on seven rows across four distinct roles (burst, exposure, fortress, sustain); no node reskins another, and the strongest build is 23 row-weighted (Taiyo Kami 31 on nine rows). Increase Damage Given is the Foundation-plus-capstone glue (+2, then +3 on two capstones; +5 ceiling) so no hybrid allocation is dominated. Pierce (Shadowrend 58), wound, stun, clearprevent and move are unsupported and untouched; no other supported tag has a row here, so none is invented."],"risks":["Classification: Shadow is the single signature element but not exclusive in the census (13 collisions, including INCLUDE bloodlines Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Godstorm Eclipse, Night Parade and Shadow Weaver); the tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification, not a bare Shadow element match. Normal-jutsu Shadow use is unverified; the current resolver matches only 4 of 7 rows directly.","Shadow Surge timing (\u00a73b, \u00a74b): its Decrease Damage Taken and Lifesteal are SELF rows realized on the caster at cast time, not tied to the circle, and like every modifier they skip the cast round: the 60 AP attack sharing Surge's 100 AP round is not lifestolen; hits dealt and taken in the two following rounds are covered. The move row is unsupported and irrelevant to potency.","Lifesteal budget: the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech cap is shared with vamp and any other lifesteal. 50% leaves 10 points of headroom, so vamp from equipment or the main tree saturates the capstone's value. Lifesteal does include pierce hits, so Shadowrend's 58 pierce feeds it when cast in Surge's window; healprevent on the caster blocks it entirely.","Increase Damage Taken reach: Shadowrend's exposure (element-less, all four stat types) amplifies every non-pierce hit the target takes in the 2 rounds after the cast, from any source, including allies, weapons and normal jutsu, so the Exposure build's low row-weight (16) understates it. Shadowrend's own pierce row gains nothing: damage modifiers skip pierce and never act in their cast round.","Arithmetic and stacking (\u00a73, \u00a73b): Cursed Beast Form's buff (up to 40%) and Shadowrend's exposure (up to 42%) each add power/100 \u00d7 staged base, so a strike under both gains 82%; only the bloodline passive multiplies. Same-tag effects from different jutsu or casters all apply and add: an ally's 42% Shadowrend on the same target makes 84% exposure. Combined final damage was not simulated.","Realized value: each window is live only the two rounds after its cast, so Cursed Beast Form's buff never raises its own 40-power hit; with one 60 AP attack per 100 AP round and cooldown 7 on all five jutsu, a window covers at most two later kit attacks, and cooldown 7 forbids recasting the same jutsu inside its own window. Per-row numbers overstate per-round value.","Shadowrend's pierce (58 at jutsu level 25) is the kit's largest hit and is unsupported; no node changes it. Only Lifesteal (Umbral Refuge's root) interacts with it.","Open decision (user-owned): Lifesteal +10 makes Maw of Oblivion an unconditional 50% leech on every hit, Shadowrend's 58 pierce included, for the 2 rounds after each 40 AP, cooldown-7 cast; it is within the +10% guardrail but has no Taiyo Kami analogue. Kept at 2/3/5 pending ruling; the trim option is 2/3/4 (+9, 49%)."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":7,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 3 / Shadow classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Oblivion Seal jutsu inherit Shadow potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":4,"lifesteal":10}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":5}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagetaken":7,"lifesteal":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 3 / Shadow classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Oblivion Seal jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Writ of Oblivion path + Umbral Refuge
Sealed Against Ruin path + Brand of Oblivion
Maw of Oblivion path + Brand of Oblivion
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
